mike.t: Scheduling rolling deploy for v2.3.1 - 15m from now. Canary to 5% us-west-2 then ramp. Release notes: https://company.internal/releases/v2.3.1 :rocket:
anna.r: noted. ops on standby, tagging release artifacts.
deploybot: Deploy v2.3.1 started (canary). id: deploy-4591234. ETA: ~20m.
eli.sre: seeing increased 504s in us-west-2 edge-ng during canary. spike started at 14:21 UTC.
mike.t: @anna can you hold further rollouts? Lowering to canary hold.
deploybot: Rollout paused by policy: incident-detected (automated). Canary halted.
ops_lead: we're investigating ingress timeouts; checking LB health and recent kernel update.
kat.p: rolling back the kernel patch on canary hosts now.
eli.sre: rollback initiated on 3 nodes. monitoring: latency back down ~30s.
mike.t: decision: keep canary paused, don't rollback app for prod yet. We'll pin v2.3.0 for the rest of the fleet.
anna.r: I'll update release notes and change window. New window proposed: tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Any objections?
ops_lead: fine from infra, need an ops signoff once we confirm no regressions.
mike.t: add canary health checks and extend canary duration before resuming. Also add automatic fallback to v2.3.0 if error rate > 1%.
eli.sre: putting an alert rule and adding a synthetic test. snippet:
```
scripts/check_canary.sh --endpoint /health --threshold 0.01
```
deploybot: Pin applied: all future automated rollouts will use v2.3.0 until explicit override.
anna.r: I'll create a follow-up release thread with pinned versions and updated notes. Reschedule: 2024-03-12 02:00 UTC.
kat.p: doc note: rollback procedure: `/ops rollback deploy-4591234 --to v2.3.0`
mike.t: thanks. next steps: confirm kernel patch rolled back, verify synths for 30m, then greenlight new window. tagging @ops_lead @eli.sre
ops_lead: ack. will post when ready.
mike.t: :thumbsup:
